title: MorphoGET: A Python Library for Morphometric Analysis of Insect Wing Shape
description: MorphoGet is a Python library (class) for morphometric analysis of insect wing shape. The class enables automatic extraction of the most informative flight activity (FA) indicators from geometric landmarks (XY-coordinates) of digitized objects. Performs Generalized Procrustes Analysis (GPA), Elliptical Fourier Analysis (EFA), correlations and visualizes morphospace for comparison and establishment.
